description:
[Game reference] One deployable: health, protection and every way to raid it. One deployable: `hp`, `protection` per damage type (fractions; negative = takes extra), `shell`, and `methods` -
every raid method with `count`, `damage_per_use`, `sulfur`: C4, rockets, satchels (`expected_lit`,
`sulfur_if_duds_lost`), explosive ammo, beancans, HV rockets, F1s, MLRS, 40mm HE, propane bombs, mortar shells,
fire (molotovs, incendiary rockets, incendiary ammo - `upper_bound`: every fireball against it), 5.56 ammo and
melee (`seconds` of hitting, `tools` worn out). Counts are direct hits or stuck charges. For 'how many satchels/rockets/C4 for an auto turret / large box / TC': every raid method with count, sulfur, dud-adjusted expected_lit, melee time. Link https://rust.wiki/raid/deployables/<shortname>.
